description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5950008999270 TRANSFORMER,POWER: Line 0001 Qty 8 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0059 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
